{{Quote|Lieutenant Deegan is an excellent pilot."''<br />''"Agreed, General, but he's from Corellia, the same as me and Corran Horn. It strikes me that having Corellia overrepresented in Rogue Squadron is not politically wise.|General [[Horton Salm/Legends|Horton Salm]] and Wedge Antilles discussing Lieutenant Deegan's potential placement in Rogue Squadron|<ref name="Rogue Squadron" />}}
'''Deegan''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Lieutenant/Legends|lieutenant]] in the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] from the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]]. In [[6 ABY/Legends|6 ABY]], while [[Wedge Antilles/Legends|Wedge Antilles]] was reforming [[Rogue Squadron/Legends|Rogue Squadron]], an elite fighter group, Deegan was chosen as a potential member. However, Antilles felt that having both himself and Corran Horn, both of whom were [[Corellian/Legends|Corellians]], on the squadron was not politically wise and could result in Corellia being overrepresented in the squadron. In place of Deegan, [[Gavin Darklighter]], a farm boy from the planet [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]] was selected to join.<ref name="Rogue Squadron" />

In [[11 ABY/Legends|11 ABY]],<ref name="TERC">''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]''</ref> Deegan served underneath [[General/Legends|General]] Antilles as part of the reconstruction efforts on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]]. When the [[EVS Construction Droid|construction droid]] Antilles' teams were supervising discovered a shielded vault within a building it was demolishing, Antilles decided to shut the droid down to inspect it, despite the fact the droid would take three [[Standard day/Legends|days]] to restart. Deegan quickly provided Antilles with the code to shut it down, and joined him, along with [[Purple team|Purple]] and [[Silver team]]s in exploring the building.<ref name="Jedi Search">''[[Jedi Search]]''</ref>
